feature_name: Homepage voice and Field Notes navigation tweaks
scope_summary: Adds one sharper brand-voice line to the homepage hero, adds a quiet latest-build note, adds reader-path cards to the Field Notes index, reorders Field Notes so grounded orientation posts appear first, and hides duplicated legacy Field Notes signoff text through scoped CSS. No new data collection, claims, scripts, payments, integrations, or clinical functionality.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: Static first-party copy and navigation changes only. The medical disclaimer remains visible on the homepage, and no regulated product claims or professional advice are added.
evidence: index.html retains 'Divergify does not diagnose, treat, or replace professional care.'
changes are limited to copy, internal links, ordering, and scoped CSS

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: No data capture, tracking, storage, form fields, analytics, or third-party calls are introduced.
evidence: index.html static copy only
field-notes/index.html internal anchors only
assets/field-notes.css display rule only

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: The language references neurodivergence, overload, shame, and support as brand/context language, not diagnosis, treatment, cure, prevention, or clinical advice.
evidence: homepage disclaimer remains present
Field Notes paths point to existing educational/context essays
no diagnostic or treatment instruction added

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: Reader paths reduce cognitive load and choice overload without coercion. Copy uses opt-in internal navigation rather than pressure, gamification, scarcity, or dark patterns.
evidence: Start here if... cards organize existing content
No modal, countdown, forced path, or manipulative CTA added

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: Changes improve orientation, reduce ambiguity, and preserve low-stimulus navigation. The homepage voice adds recognition without turning neurodivergence into a cure/superpower claim.
evidence: Grounded posts moved before higher-voltage manifesto posts
Brain Dump path clearly identified for overloaded users

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Benefit is clearer brand trust, easier content entry, and less duplicated legacy copy. Foreseeable harm is low because no functionality, data flow, or purchase pressure changes.
evidence: Field Notes page adds clearer reading order
CSS hides duplicate signoff while preserving CTA

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Restores Divergify's blunt, human, lightly sarcastic voice while avoiding inflated 'genius/superpower' positioning on the front door.
evidence: Homepage line: 'Your brain is not the problem. The interface is.'
Older manifesto posts remain available but no longer lead the Field Notes list

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: Uses semantic sections, headings, cards, and standard internal links. No inaccessible interactive control or visual-only information added.
evidence: field-notes/index.html uses aria-labelledby on new sections
links remain standard anchor elements

security_and_reliability.rationale: No new JavaScript, dependencies, network calls, auth changes, secrets, or build process changes. CSS rule is scoped to Field Notes article pages.
evidence: No script tags or imports added
CSS selector is scoped to body[data-field-notes='true'][data-field-notes-view='article']

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: Dopamine Depot link was already present and no new purchase pressure, scarcity, urgency, subscription, payment, or upsell mechanism was added.
evidence: No new payment link or checkout flow
No scarcity or countdown language

ship_decision.conditions: All pillars pass. Change is static, additive, low risk, and aligned with Divergify's low-shame, low-stimulus positioning.
